validations_executed.evidence: Scoreboard renders three rows: Synonym/category (HD 30% / Lowe's 48%), Dimension/notation & hash (HD 0.90 / Lowe's 0.88 NDCG), Pro/job-function (HD 0.83 / Lowe's 0.78 NDCG). Confirmed live in the browser (Home Depot view) with 240+ product-grade badges rendered.

Relevance datasets expand from dataset score to per-query NDCG rows (severity dot + NDCG% + count-ratio/Jaccard chips) and from each query to per-product grade badges (3->0) with the judge's one-line reason.

Notation defect (1/2-in read as size mismatch) and 'No.' abbreviation defect (no 8 read as negation) reproduced, fixed via strengthened rubric (12/13 hand-labelled gold, stable across 3 temp-0 runs), delivered to the Cortex session and deployed to the default rubric. Re-judged: no 8 wood screw HD 0.91 / Lowe's 1.00; dimensions rose to HD 0.90 / Lowe's 0.88.

48-char title truncation clipped product nouns; full-title re-capture of the 10 fastener queries per retailer raised HD fastener mean NDCG 0.785->0.895 (and further with the deployed rubric), correcting both under- and over-scores.

Confirmed in-browser: 12 nav items, 3 dataset rows, 308 grade badges, report link present.
